properties.name: hospitops.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Allowed CORS origins for the API. Injected into SecurityConfig. Defaults to http://localhost:5500 for local development; override via FRONTEND_URL env var in production.

properties.name: hospitops.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC secret for JWT signing. Must be at least 32 characters. Set via JWT_SECRET env var in production.

properties.name: hospitops.jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT token validity in milliseconds. Defaults to 28800000 (8 hours). Set via JWT_EXPIRATION_MS env var.

properties.name: hospitops.redis.enabled
properties.description: Activates the Redis-backed token blacklist (RedisConfig + RedisTokenBlacklist). When false (default) the in-memory blacklist is used — safe for local dev and single-replica environments. Set via REDIS_ENABLED env var.
